metadata.title: mixed Hodge structures on the strictly upper triangular Lie algebras
metadata.abstract: We show that, for $k\geq 3$, a lattice in the unitriangular Lie group $U_k(\mathbb{R})$ is the fundamental group of a smooth quasi-projective complex algebraic variety if and only if $k=3$. The proof uses the conjugation symmetry and weight conditions of mixed Hodge structure on the Malcev Lie algebra proven by Morgan. This result identifies a family of groups that must be excluded in the search for smooth quasi-projective varieties with torsion-free nilpotent fundamental groups of high nilpotency class.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明上单位三角群 Uk(R) 的格在 k≥3 时成为光滑拟射影复代数簇基本群的充要条件为 k=3，借 Malcev 李代数的混合 Hodge 权重与共轭对称性排除更高 k。
techniques: Morgan 混合 Hodge 结构
analysis.breakthrough: 为高幂零阶基本群的拟射影可实现性给出一族排除结果。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。针对指定单位三角群的格，不是对所有高阶幂零拟射影群的完全分类。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第 1.4 节明确披露 ChatGPT 用于语言编辑及其他编辑辅助；对引理证明的改进在随后致谢中归于导师，不能混记为 AI 贡献。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.23505v1 · PDF 第 4 页，第 1.4 节 AI Declaration
